# Planview ProjectPlace - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Collaborative work management for teams to plan, share documents and track work using boards and plans.

Also known as: ProjectPlace. Solution areas: Collaborative Work Management. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Collaborative work management** - a core capability of Planview ProjectPlace: Team collaboration on tasks, documents and plans.
- **Project management** - a supported capability of Planview ProjectPlace: Plan and execute projects: schedules, tasks, milestones, dependencies.
- **Kanban / visual boards** - a supported capability of Planview ProjectPlace: Visual boards for flow-based work management with WIP limits.

## Implementation considerations

- Best suited to team collaboration; pair with a portfolio product when enterprise portfolio governance is required.
